result.title: Path to Prior-Data Fitted Relational Models via Learned Latent Multi-table Representations
result.comment: Presented at the Fifth Learning on Graphs Conference (LoG 2026), Boston, MA, USA, November 20-22, 2026
result.summary: Prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) show that pretraining on large populations of synthetic tasks can enable generalization to unseen datasets with little or no downstream fine-tuning. This paradigm is effective for transformer-based tabular and relational foundation models such as RDB-PFN, but remains largely unexplored for graph-based relational models built on message passing. We pretrain the graph-based relational foundation model Griffin on large collections of synthetic relational databases and ask whether curriculum learning, which benefits transformer-based relational learners, also improves message-passing representations. Rather than fine-tune on downstream tasks, we use the pretrained encoder as a general-purpose relational representation learner and pass its latent representations to a frozen in-context predictor (\ticl{}); no component is trained on the target task. On 16 real-world relational classification tasks, evaluated over five seeds against raw-feature and untrained-encoder baselines, a purely synthetic curriculum that begins with schema-guided data and continues with schema-agnostic data gives the strongest frozen in-context performance\rev{, outperforming real-data-only pretraining and every unordered single-stage mixture of the corpora; when appended after real-data pretraining, it yields the best encoders overall}. These results provide initial evidence that PFN-style synthetic pretraining transfers to graph-based relational foundation models.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把基于消息传递的图关系基础模型 Griffin 在大量合成关系数据库上预训练，考察课程学习是否改善其表示；并将其 latent 表示送入冻结的 in-context 预测器（无组件在目标任务上训练），在 16 个真实关系分类任务上比较不同预训练数据顺序的效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 「冻结 in-context 预测器读取 latent 表示」与「合成数据课程塑造表示」的设置，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的训练监督、表示质量评估提供借鉴线索；但领域属图/表格关系学习，与视觉多模态推理距离较远，是否可迁移需核查。
